summary: Frontend-only verification of the switch-to-switch uplink cascade fix (local_chassis_id matching). Admin login with 2FA TOTP OK. CHASW-B (/switch-ports/10.10.41.220?clientId=da3d6e40-...) now renders data-testid=switch-uplinks-summary with exactly 2 SWITCH rows: 'Porta 25 · Ten-GigabitEthernet1/0/25 -> CHASW-A (10.10.41.221), porta remota Ten-GigabitEthernet1/0/50 · VLAN 10, ✓ VERIFICATO' and 'Porta 26 · Ten-GigabitEthernet1/0/26 -> CHASW-C (10.10.41.222), porta remota Ten-GigabitEthernet1/0/25 · VLAN 10, ✓ VERIFICATO'. Filter chip data-testid=port-filter-switch_uplink shows 'Uplink 2'; clicking it filters the matrix to exactly ports 25 and 26 (table becomes 'Tabella completa (2 fisiche)' with HPE peers 192.168.101.4 / 192.168.88.9 in 'Connesso a'). Counterproof on CHASW-C (10.10.41.222): panel shows 1 SWITCH uplink Porta 25 -> CHASW-B (10.10.41.220) porta remota Ten-GigabitEthernet1/0/26, ✓ VERIFICATO, chip 'Uplink 1'. No crash, no white page, no functional console error (only a pre-login 403 on /api/auth/me, benign).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Uplink panel port tiles do not use data-testid=port-tile-*; verify tile filtering via the 'Tabella completa (N fisiche)' heading or screenshot instead. Cascade fix verified end-to-end on CHASW-B/CHASW-C.
